goal: Delete the plugins/immune-brain/runtime/imm_core.ts re-export barrel and repoint every importer at the concrete module that defines each symbol. The barrel has no non-test importer, so no production path changes; the two scripts that match the string imm_core match the retired .imm/imm_core Python paths and are unrelated to this module. This slice exists on its own because it converts the v3 runtime island from referenced-through-a-barrel to referenced-by-nothing, which is the seam the island deletion in the next slice depends on. Import rewiring must preserve the exact symbol each test consumed, because a barrel removal is precisely where an accidental repoint to a same-named but different symbol would hide behind a still-green suite. Two files name the barrel by path string rather than importing it and must be corrected rather than weakened: python-reference-boundary.test.ts asserts the barrel exists, and pi-only-current-contracts.test.ts reads it to scan for forbidden progress-projection and host-selector tokens, so the barrel leaves those lists while the token scans stay intact. Deleting the seven v3 island modules, trimming partially live runtime, and the kernel v1 store question are deliberately out of scope for this slice.

acceptance.assertion: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/imm_core.ts does not exist, no file in the repository imports it, and no test asserts its existence or reads it by path.

Every module that previously imported through the barrel now imports the same symbol names directly from the module that defines them, with no symbol dropped, added, or substituted, and the token scans in pi-only-current-contracts.test.ts still cover every remaining live runtime source they covered before.
